name: Wooly
source:
The strange goat man is mute, but more expressive than most. His eyes regard you with too many feelings to count; pity, wariness, doubt... If only you could ask him why.

[From [url=https://maneki-mushi.itch.io/theherosjourney]itch.io[/url]]
